families.conditional: Editor type, operator, field metadata, grouping mode and date-variable settings control rendered widgets.
Permissions govern name/search/role controls; selected view governs Remove; source uses react-beautiful-dnd.

families.identity: Widget test ID equals exact field key. Label comes from configuration. A query ButtonItem can duplicate field test ID; narrow by role.

families.conditional: Resize enabled governs maximize; disableClose governs close. Close Chip differs from footer Close button.

families.scope: Main blotter grid or explicit nested grid
families.identity: Cashflow source defines row ID as Cashflow.Cashflow_Id. col-id identifies dynamic columns. AG Grid generated selectors need runtime validation.

limits: Source inspection establishes control expressions, not deployed accessible names or runtime uniqueness.
AntD virtual Select needs its visible dropdown. The POM resolves that dropdown through the opener association. Calendar internals require explicit popup scopes.
AG Grid library DOM selectors have no retained deployed DOM proof.
Metadata and permission state determine dynamic fields and options.
React Beautiful DnD supports keyboard interactions through generated draggable handles; exact generated attributes require runtime verification.
